description: Mediation Boards Commission - Calling for Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators to Kurunegala and to 09 other Administrative Districts
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. The Mediation Boards Commission operates under the Ministry of Justice and deals with dispute resolution mechanisms, making this a judicial administration matter rather than a general government personnel or structural change.
